Minor heading adjustment (12°) aligned with the prevailing surface current direction.

evidenceList: Closest Point of Approach (CPA) of 1.8 km within estimated spill release time window.
Vessel track overlaps the Lagrangian backwards drift origin corridor (uncertainty: ±3.1 km).
Vessel type 'Crude Oil Tanker' has relevant cargo/ballast handling profile under MARPOL Annex I.
counterEvidenceList: No satellite optical corroboration at exact moment of alleged discharge.
Hydrodynamic current shear introduces spatial uncertainty in the backwards advection trajectory.
attributionScores.disclaimer: This attribution score is a forensic probabilistic assessment based on trajectory correlation and does not constitute a legal conviction.
